title: TourGuide Turtle
wikitext:
'''TourGuide''' is a powerleveling and questing guide framework. It provides step-by-step instructions, quest tracking, and guide management to streamline leveling and quest progression. == Installation == '''GitAddonsManager''' The easiest way to keep '''TourGuide''' up to date is by using [[GitAddonsManager]]. # '''Add the Repository:''' Add the following URL to GitAddonsManager: https://github.com/vaniron/TourGuide-Turtle.git # '''Select the Branch:''' Ensure that the master branch is selected. # '''Update:''' Using GitAddonsManager, you can check for and install updates for all your AddOns with a single click. '''Manual Installation''' If you prefer manual installation, follow these steps: # Download manually via GitHub by clicking on '''[<> Code]''' -> Download ZIP # Rename the folder to "TourGuide-Turtle" # Move the folder into TWoW/Interface/AddOns # Restart Turtle wow '''Optional''': * '''[[TourGuide Professions]]''' * '''[[TomTom]]''' * '''[[pfQuest]]'''
== Git links == * '''[https://github.com/cralor/TourGuideVanilla (cralor)] -''' This version support TourGuide professions. The folder needs to be renamed to TourGuideVanilla * [https://github.com/vaniron/TourGuide-Turtle '''(vaniron)'''] - This Version is Tweaked for Turtle WoW * [https://github.com/LarsArnth/TourGuide-Turtle '''(LarsArnth)'''] - This Version is Tweaked for Turtle WoW == Commands == * '''/tg''' — Open the guide interface and settings. * '''/tourguide''' — Alternative command to open the guide UI. == '''Features''' == * Automatic detection of objective completion ** Detect quest accept, completion and turn-in ** Detect travel (by foot, flight, boat and stone) ** Detection of flight point discovery ** Detection of Hearth point change * Conditionals based on player’s class and item possession (only tell the player to accept the quest if they have the item that starts the quest) * Small “Lego block” style frame shows current objective, detailed tool-tips on hover * “Use item” frame, for those annoying quests where you have to use an item on a mob before you kill it, or you have to equip something, or you have to use an item to start a quest * Pop out frame for detailed view of quest sequence * Automatic mapping of coordinates with TomTom and quest-giver locations from pfQuest if installed == Preview == Screenshot of the Guide List, with the Status Frame on the top right. [[File:TG1.png|frameless|580x580px]] == FAQs == '''Q:''' How do I switch between guides? * '''A:''' Use the Guide List panel to select a different guide. '''Q:''' How can I reset a guide? * '''A:''' Shift-click the guide in the Guide List to reset its progress. '''Q:''' How does auto quest tracking work? * '''A:''' Enable "Auto Track" in options; the addon will automatically track quests you are working on. '''Q:''' Can I skip follow-up quests automatically? * '''A:''' Yes, enable "Skip Follow-Ups" to automatically skip suggested follow-up quests. '''Q:''' How do I report guide errors? * '''A:''' Enable debugging with /tg debug and review error messages in chat. == Contributors == * [https://github.com/TekNoLogic/TourGuide Tekkub] * [https://github.com/cralor Cralor] * [https://github.com/Road-block/TourGuideVanilla Road-block] * [https://github.com/rsheep Rsheep] * [https://github.com/Azgaardian Azgaardian] * [https://github.com/Kyliexx/TourGuideVanilla Kyliexx] * [https://github.com/laytya/TourGuideVanilla laytya] * [https://github.com/Ez-mode Ez-mode] * [https://github.com/Azgaardian/TourGuide-Turtle Azgaardian] * [https://github.com/Gescht/TourGuide-Turtle Gescht] * [https://github.com/vaniron/TourGuide-Turtle Vaniron] [[Category:Addon]] {{DEFAULTSORT:TourGuide}}
